verdict.rationale: Reranking is a fair axis for a vector database, but the evidence pack never mentions reranking or reranker models. The pack only covers embedding model choice, full-text and regex search, sparse BM25/SPLADE search, and metadata filtering. Those are adjacent search features, not built-in or first-party reranking.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can rerank search results with built-in or first-party-integrated reranking models
